Passages:
[1] [GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Parental Leave**]
Comprehensive parental leave combining New Zealand statutory entitlements with GitLab's enhanced support for growing families.

Primary Carer Leave

- Team members who have been employed for at least six months and become a "Primary Carer" as defined under the Parental Leave and Employment Protection Act 1987 can receive government-funded parental leave pay (Primary Carer Leave).
- A Primary Carer is either the biological mother OR a person (that is not the biological mother or her spouse/partner) who will take primary responsibility for the care, development, and upbringing of a child under six years old on a permanent basis.
- Primary Carer Leave can last up to 26 weeks and must be taken in one continuous period.
- Primary Carer Leave typically starts on the due date or date of birth, but may begin up to 6 weeks earlier if arrangements are made between the team member and manager.

Extended Leave Options

**Extended Parental Leave:**

[2] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves]
GitLab France offers comprehensive parental leave benefits that meet or exceed statutory requirements. Whether you're welcoming your first child or growing your family, we provide the time and financial support you need during this important life transition.

[3] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parent's Leave]
Extended support for new parents.  

Leave Entitlement

- 9 weeks leave in child's first 2 years  
- Can be taken consecutively or separately  
- State Parent's Benefit available (subject to PRSI)  
- GitLab salary top-up applies if taken within the first 16 weeks of GitLab's Parental Leave

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Apply for benefit via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/b321b1-parents-benefit/) 4 weeks before leave

[4] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Paternity Leave]
Eligibility Requirements

- All team members after birth of child
- Includes births to spouse, common-law partner, or PACS partner
- Must submit leave request 30 days in advance

Leave Entilement

- Total leave: 28 days (35 days for multiple births)
- Structure: 3 days mandatory at birth + 4 days immediately following + 21 additional days
- 21-day period can be split into two segments (minimum 5 days each)
- GitLab pays 100% salary for first 3 days
- GitLab supplements social security benefits to provide 100% salary for first 16 weeks
- [Review eligibility for social security benefits](https://www.ameli.fr/assure/remboursements/indemnites-journalieres/conge-paternite-accueil-enfant)

How to Apply

1. Submit "Parental Leave" request in Workday at least 30 days before leave start date
2. Review [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)
3. Apply for social security benefits as applicable
4. Provide required documentation to leaves@gitlab.com

[5] [Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave]
GitLab's Parental Leave is available for any active team member (regardless of gender) who becomes a parent through childbirth, adoption, fostering, or surrogacy (intended parent) while working at GitLab. This benefit is available from your first day of employment, provided your child was born, newly adopted, newly placed in your foster care, or born via surrogacy during your employment at GitLab.

GitLab provides 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave, which must be used prior to the child's first birthday, the first anniversary of the adoption, the first anniversary of the foster placement, or the first anniversary of the birth (for surrogacy). Team members are encouraged to decide for themselves how much time they'd like to take, but there are some parameters to keep in mind when planning your leave:

[6] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Maternity Leave]
Eligibility Requirements

- All pregnant team members
- Coverage begins from hire date
- Must submit leave request 30 days in advance

Leave Entitlement

- First or second child: 16 weeks (6 weeks before birth, 10 weeks after)
- Third child: 26 weeks (8 weeks before birth, 18 weeks after)
- Twins: 34 weeks (12 weeks before birth, 22 weeks after)
- Triplets or more: 46 weeks (24 weeks before birth, 22 weeks after)
- GitLab supplements social security benefits to provide 100% salary for first 16 weeks
- [Review eligibility for social security benefits](https://www.ameli.fr/assure/remboursements/indemnites-journalieres/conge-maternite-salariee)

How to Apply

1. Submit "Parental Leave" request in Workday at least 30 days before leave start date
2. Review [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)
3. Apply for social security benefits as applicable
4. Provide required documentation to leaves@gitlab.com

Question: If I move from GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand to GitLab France S.A.S., how does the length of paid parental leave differ for a first child?

Answer:
For a first child, GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand offers up to 26 weeks of Primary Carer Leave [1]. In contrast, GitLab France S.A.S. provides 16 weeks of maternity leave for a first child [6]. Therefore, the length of paid parental leave is 10 weeks longer in New Zealand than in France for a first child.
